body_html:
What a great night full of fun,dancing and down home entertainment. The reception took place at The Hilton Garden Inn in Laramie,WY and was a night to remember. After the formalities of the ceremony that took place earlier in the day the bride and groom were ready to kick off their shoes for a night filled with dancing. This 7 hour reception took it to the next level with our Platinum package set-up. With over 200 people in attendance more than 50 people still remained at the end of the night(still enough to pack the dance floor) and were chanting my name to give them more.

~ Steve Smith ~
